description: This file contains unit tests for the RebaselineCL command in the WebKit Python testing framework, specifically testing rebaselining behavior, handling of build and test results, and command execution logic.

classes.name: RebaselineCLTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the RebaselineCL command's behavior, including test execution, handling of build results, and rebaseline logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, mocks build results, git interactions, and test results data.

methods.name: command_options
methods.description: Creates and returns command line options with default or overridden values.

methods.name: test_execute_with_issue_number_given
methods.description: Tests rebaseline execution when an issue number is provided.

methods.name: test_execute_with_no_issue_number
methods.description: Tests behavior when no issue number is available.

methods.name: test_execute_with_issue_number_from_branch
methods.description: Tests rebaseline execution when issue number is retrieved from branch.

methods.name: test_execute_with_only_changed_tests_option
methods.description: Tests rebaseline with the 'only changed tests' option enabled.

methods.name: test_execute_with_flaky_test_that_fails_on_retry
methods.description: Tests rebaseline behavior with flaky tests that fail on retries.

methods.name: test_execute_with_no_retry_summary_downloaded
methods.description: Tests rebaseline when retry summary is unavailable.

methods.name: test_execute_with_trigger_jobs_option
methods.description: Tests triggering of try jobs via command options.

methods.name: test_rebaseline_calls
methods.description: Verifies the sequence of commands invoked during rebaseline.

methods.name: test_trigger_builds
methods.description: Tests the trigger_builds method for initiating try jobs.

methods.name: test_builders_with_pending_builds
methods.description: Checks detection of builders with pending (unfinished) builds.

methods.name: test_bails_when_one_build_is_missing_results
methods.description: Ensures execution stops if build results are missing.

methods.name: test_bails_when_there_are_unstaged_baselines
methods.description: Ensures execution stops if unstaged baseline files are detected.
